I farm wheat and maize on the same 30 mu, so I will keep the wheat-maize rotation on all of my land. At my age, with only two people in the household and some labor going off-farm, I will choose a steady, familiar way of farming that does not depend on too much extra field work. I have well irrigation, so I will use it to protect yield rather than gamble on rainfall. For wheat, I will use improved seed, apply a moderate but reliable amount of fertilizer, irrigate at the key stages, and control weeds and disease with a few timely sprays. For summer maize, I will use hybrid seed because it gives stronger yield, keep fertilizer at a moderate level, irrigate when summer rain is not enough, and reduce labor by using rotary tillage rather than deeper ploughing. I am not chasing the highest possible yield; I am aiming for stable output, manageable labor, and lower risk on 30 mu.
